title: 《遗忘之海》新手入门完全指南
titleEn: Sea of Remnants Complete Beginner Guide
summary: 面向7月9日PC公测的新手路线：预下载、预约奖励、6选1黑券、首日主线、号角每日4次和第一队养成。
summaryEn: A July 9 PC open beta beginner route covering preload, launch rewards, 6-choice Black Ticket, day-one story, four daily Horn attempts, and first-team investment.
content:
## 开服前 4 件事

1. 7月6日 10:00 后完成 PC 预下载和预创角。
2. 领取预约、七日签到和首日邮件奖励。
3. 先看首次记忆重逢 6 选 1，再决定黑券目标。
4. 第一队固定为 1 主攻 + 1 辅助 + 1 生存。

## 首日路线

| 阶段 | 目标 |
|---|---|
| 0-30分钟 | 登录、领奖、基础设置 |
| 30-120分钟 | 推主线，解锁奥托皮亚、招募、日常 |
| 首次招募后 | 按缺口选择 6 选 1 |
| 当天收尾 | 清号角每日 4 次，整理装备和材料 |

## 推荐第一队

| 队伍 | 船员 | 场景 |
|---|---|---|
| 追击开荒 | 小斧头 + 饿猫（Stray Cat） + 茉莉 | 单体和推图 |
| 智力清场 | 海葬 + 伊莎贝拉 + 生存位 | 群体和机制战 |
| 稳健泛用 | 茉莉 + 黑格 + 盖尔 | 长线培养 |

资源优先给主攻等级和核心技能，辅助只升关键增益，生存位保证不倒即可。下一步看 [招募系统指南](./gacha-recruitment-guide)。
contentEn:
## Four Things Before Launch

1. Complete PC preload and character creation after July 6, 10:00.
2. Claim reservation, seven-day login, and launch mail rewards.
3. Understand the first Memory Reunion 6-choice selector before picking.
4. Build one DPS, one support, and one survival slot.

## Day-One Route

| Stage | Goal |
|---|---|
| 0-30 min | Login, claim rewards, adjust settings |
| 30-120 min | Push story, unlock Orbtopia, Recruitment, dailies |
| After first recruitment | Pick the 6-choice unit that fills your gap |
| End of day | Clear four Horn attempts and sort gear |

## Starter Teams

| Team | Crew | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Follow-up | Little Axe + Glutton Cat (Stray Cat) + Molly | Story and single-target |
| INT clear | Sea Burial + Isabella + survival | AoE and mechanics |
| Stable core | Molly + Heige + Gail | Long-term progression |

Prioritize DPS level and core skills, then key support skills, then enough survival investment.

faq.question: What should I do first in Sea of Remnants?
faq.questionZh: 遗忘之海开局应该做什么？
faq.answer: Follow the main story to unlock Orbtopia features, then focus on recruiting and leveling your main DPS crew member.
faq.answerZh: 跟随主线剧情解锁奥托皮亚功能，然后集中资源招募和提升主攻船员。

faq.question: Is there a gacha system?
faq.questionZh: 遗忘之海有抽卡系统吗？
faq.answer: Yes, the game uses a Recruitment system with ticket currencies. Beginner banner has 40-pull pity, limited banners have 80-pull pity.
faq.answerZh: 有的，游戏使用票据货币的招募系统。新手池40抽保底，限定池80抽保底。

faq.question: Are Black Ticket characters stronger than Purple Ticket?
faq.answer: No. The developers have explicitly stated that Black Ticket and Purple Ticket characters are equal in combat power.
faq.answerZh: 不是。官方明确声明黑券与紫券角色战力平等。
